name: ai-architect-executor
description: The generic, protocol-agnostic Architect/Executor pattern for delegating work from an orchestrating AI to a worker AI - task discovery, isolation, delegation, monitoring, verification, and a headless-worker behavioral contract

plugins.name: architect-side
plugins.description: Orchestration methodology (6 phases), delegation ROI analysis, conflict resolution, task-spec authoring, and manual task-delegation/git-worktree mechanics - all protocol-agnostic. Install if you're the orchestrating AI. Concrete tool bindings for a specific executor live in that binding's own repo, e.g. kilo-mcp.

plugins.name: executor-side
plugins.description: The headless-executor behavioral contract - zero interactivity, focus_files, mandatory Final Report, fail fast. Install if you're the agent executing background work delegated by an orchestrating Architect AI.

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: interactive-role-setup - maps the kit's abstract role profiles to whatever models/hosts you actually have. Useful regardless of which side you install.
